source: Six learner attempts saved as one batch
lessonTheme: Infinitive versus command, then regular negative tú commands
summary: Correctly contrasted Queremos probarla / Pruébala and Necesitamos leerla / Léela, with command accents supplied. Introduced regular negative tú -ar → -es; correct No revises esta función after a model and correct transfer No crees esta función without conjugated target supplied.

observations.outcome: Correct infinitive probarla after queremos in a command-versus-infinitive contrast.
Correct switch from probarla to personal command pruébala; accent/capitalization supplied.
Correct infinitive leer + la after necesitamos, without a full target model.
Correct switch from leerla to command léela; accent/capitalization supplied. Tutor then introduced revisa versus no revises and regular negative tú -ar → -es.

observations.learnerText: no revises esta funcion por favor
observations.correctedText: No revises esta función, por favor.
observations.outcome: Correct no revises after negative model, retaining esta función. Standard capitalization, función accent and conventional punctuation supplied.

observations.learnerText: no crees esta funcion por favor
observations.correctedText: No crees esta función, por favor.
observations.outcome: Correct transfer of regular negative tú -es ending to crear, including full cre- stem and double e in crees. No conjugated crear target supplied. Spelling/punctuation supplied.
